changes.summary: Optional boolean (defaults to true) that controls whether calls can be placed to the group.
Message media settings are now mapped with message-specific read and write logic, including sub_type_settings and service-level fields.
Refresh populates calls_enabled from the API.
Refresh maps media_settings_message with message-specific fields, which can surface sub_type_settings and service-level values that were previously omitted or flattened incorrectly.
Read retries when the API returns an empty route list or when the route is not found in its domain, instead of clearing the resource from state.
Create and update send calls_enabled to the Genesys Cloud API.
Plan and apply operations that cannot obtain a pooled OAuth client within token_acquire_timeout fail with a timeout error instead of blocking indefinitely.
Provider startup fails if the token pool cannot be initialized within token_init_timeout.
Exported Terraform block labels now use Integration-{integration_name} instead of {integration_name}_{credential_name}.
Export preserves zero-value entries in translation_map_defaults.
Bulk export limits concurrent resource enumeration to the configured token_pool_size.
Optional duration for waiting on an available OAuth client from the token pool (default 5m).
Optional duration for initializing the token pool at provider startup (default 10m).
Optional boolean that enables debug logging for token pool operations.
